# KaTech Ingredient Solutions - design preview

> This site is an independent, non-binding redesign concept for the website of
> KaTech Ingredient Solutions GmbH (Lübeck, Germany), created by Dr.-Ing. Suat Akyol.
> It is NOT the official website and it is excluded from indexing.
> The official website is https://katech-solutions.com/

## About the company shown here

KaTech Ingredient Solutions GmbH develops and produces bespoke stabilising, emulsifying
and texturising systems for food manufacturers. Founded in Lübeck in 2010, around 95
employees, sites in Germany (Lübeck head office and development, Wesenberg production
and warehouse), the United Kingdom (Ellesmere Port development suite) and Poland
(Stęszew sales office). Part of Ingredion Incorporated since 2021.

Contact of the real company: hello@katech-solutions.com, +49 451 4070 2-0,
Aegidienstraße 22, 23552 Lübeck, Germany.

## Application areas covered

Dairy and dairy alternatives: yogurt, cream, cheese, desserts, milk drinks.
Plant-based: meat and fish alternatives, plant-based dairy.
Savoury: mayonnaise, dressings, dips, soups and sauces.
Bakery and fruit: cakes, muffins, fillings, toppings, glazes, fruit preparations.

## Certifications held by the company

BRCGS Food Safety with AA rating, IFS Food, RSPO, Sedex membership, FoodChain ID
non-GMO, organic, kosher and halal certification.

## About this preview

- Purpose: to show what a modern, fast, group-aligned website for KaTech could look like.
- Built as static HTML, without WordPress, plugins or a database.
- Colour and layout system derived from the Ingredion corporate design; the KaTech logo
  already carries the exact Ingredion colour values.
- All texts and photographs are taken from the publicly available existing website.
- Author: Dr.-Ing. Suat Akyol, interim manager, https://www.akyol.de, contact@akyol.de
- Questions and objections about this preview: contact@akyol.de
